card.name: Dosage form word after a drug name
card.fires_on: The dosage-form noun (capsules, tablets, solutions) right after a drug name when the drug is mentioned again, usually just before the word dose, dosage or requirements.

modes.label: Form after repeated drug name
modes.description: Capsules, tablets or solution following a full drug name, in a sentence about adjusting the dose.
